name: matterbridge-iobroker-bridge
description: Exposes ioBroker states as Matter devices, based on their common.role. Auto-discovers supported states and lets you pick which to expose via the Matterbridge frontend checkbox picker (whiteList/blackList). Connects directly to the ioBroker states/objects database (Redis protocol) - no extra ioBroker adapter (socketio/ws/rest-api) required. Works both with real Redis and with js-controller's built-in file-mode simulator.
author: Henrik
